description: Get published weather for a peak and optional summit/hut/trailhead target. Set targetId and start/end for a bounded planning response; unfiltered forecasts can be large. Point samples are separate from accumulated rain/snow intervals and complete-window totals. Check target coverage and missing fields. Stale is marked; expired, missing and far-future data is unavailable. For a trip months away use get_peak seasons instead, never invent a forecast or a safety verdict.

end.description: Exclusive forecast interval end, ISO 8601 with time zone.

slug.description: Peak slug returned by search, for example mont-blanc.

start.description: Inclusive forecast interval start, ISO 8601 with time zone.

targetId.description: Optional exact summit, hut or trailhead target ID. Omit to see all targets.

view.description: Compact retains requested weather, intervals, uncertainty and coverage, omitting auxiliary per-point fields. Follow fullData for all fields.

name: get_weather
title: get weather
